briefdescription.para: When regcall calling convention compiled to 32 bit arch, special treatment is required for 64 bit masks.

detaileddescription.para:
The value should be assigned to two GPRs.
true if registers were allocated and false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Vectorcall calling convention has special handling for vector types or HVA for 64 bit arch.

detaileddescription.para:
For HVAs shadow registers might be allocated on the first pass and actual XMM registers are allocated on the second pass. For vector types, actual XMM registers are allocated on the first pass.
true if registers were allocated and false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Vectorcall calling convention has special handling for vector types or HVA for 32 bit arch.

detaileddescription.para:
For HVAs actual XMM registers are allocated on the second pass. For vector types, actual XMM registers are allocated on the first pass.
true if registers were allocated and false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: X86 interrupt handlers can only take one or two stack arguments, but if there are two arguments, they are in the opposite order from the standard convention.

detaileddescription.para: Therefore, we have to look at the argument count up front before allocating stack for each argument.

briefdescription.para: Special handling for i128: Either allocate the value to two consecutive i64 registers, or to the stack.

detaileddescription.para: Do not partially allocate in registers, and do not reserve any registers when allocating to the stack.
